title: Doctor Appointment Scheduler
problem: Patients face difficulty booking doctor appointments efficiently and managing schedules digitally.
impact: Developed a full-stack platform enabling doctor search, appointment booking, and real-time confirmations with secure role-based access for patients and doctors.

title: Career AI – Recommendation System
problem: Students often lack personalized guidance when choosing career paths based on skills and market trends.
impact: Built an AI-driven system that analyzes user profiles and suggests optimal career paths using machine learning, improving decision-making accuracy.

title: Plag-X – Plagiarism Detection Tool
problem: Manual plagiarism detection is time-consuming and inefficient for academic content verification.
impact: Created a Flask-based tool that analyzes document similarity using web scraping and text comparison techniques, improving detection efficiency.

title: Retail Data Analysis (EDA)
problem: Businesses struggle to extract actionable insights from large retail datasets.
impact: Performed exploratory data analysis to uncover sales trends, customer behavior, and product performance, enabling data-driven decisions.
